The '''74th [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' were held on March 20, 2022, to honor the best writing in film, television and radio of 2021. The nominees for television and radio were announced on January 13, 2022, while the nominees for the film categories were announced on January 27, 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2022/01/wga-awards-tv-nominations-2022-list-1234912197/|title=WGA Awards TV Nominations: 'Yellowjackets', 'Hacks', 'Loki', 'Only Murders In The Building' Join Usual Suspects On List|website=[[Deadline Hollywood|Deadline]]|first=Patrick|last=Hipes|date=January 13, 2022|accessdate=January 14, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2022/tv/news/writers-guild-2022-tv-award-nominations-1235153140/|title=Writers Guild Unveils 2022 WGA TV Award Nominees: 'Yellowjackets,' 'Hacks,' 'Reservation Dogs,' 'Only Murders in the Building' and More|website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|first=Michael|last=Schneider|date=January 13, 2022|accessdate=January 14, 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2022/awards/awards/wga-awards-nominations-2022-dont-look-up-king-richard-coda-dune-1235165237/|title=2022 WGA Awards Nominations: 'CODA', 'Don't Look Up' and 'Dune' Contending in the Screenplay Categories|website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|first=Clayton|last=Davies|date=January 27, 2022|accessdate=January 27, 2022}}</ref>

== Winners and nominees ==
Winners are listed first and in '''bold'''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/writers-guild-awards-2022-winners-list-1235115399/|title=WGA Awards: ''CODA'', ''Don't Look Up'' Win Best Adapted, Original Screenplays|date=March 20, 2022|first=Hilary|last=Lewis|website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]|access-date=March 21, 2022}}</ref>
